    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    AppDirectoryType
    Enum AppDirectoryType defines the types of subdirectories used by the PetriObjModelPaint application within the user's home directory (typically located at ~/.PetriObjModelPaint).
    AppSettings
    The user's application-wide preferences: ~/.PetriObjModelPaint/configs/ui.properties, next to the caches and logs the app already keeps in the user's home.
    ArcIn
    This class for creating the arc between place and transition of Petri net (and directed from place to transion) numP - number of place numT - number of transition k - arc multiplicity inf - flag of information arc
    ArcOut
    This class for creating the arc between transition and place of Petri net (and directed from transion to place)
    CanvasColor
    The roles a colour can play in the net drawing.
    CanvasItem
    Something on the canvas an operation can act on without caring which kind it turned out to be: a place or transition (GraphElement), or the frame that marks out a Petri-object (GraphObjectFrame).
    CanvasPalette
    Every colour the net drawing uses, in one place, so that switching the application between light and dark is a matter of swapping one object rather than hunting literals through the painters.
    ChartConfigDto
     
    ContributorProfile
    Optional, locally declared attribution.
    CoordinateNormalizer
    Normalizes coordinates from PNML files exported by different tools.
    CoordinateNormalizer.BoundingBox
     
    CoordinateNormalizer.NormalizationResult
     
    DataCollectionConfigDto
     
    ExceptionInvalidNetStructure
     
    ExceptionInvalidTimeDelay
    This exception is generated when user tries to construct Petri net with transition that has no input positions or output positions, and also if Petri net has no any position or any transition.
    ExternalArc
    A weighted arc from a transition of one Petri-object into a place that belongs to another Petri-object.
    FilePathConfig
    Centralized file path configuration for the application.
    FiringPhase
    One atomic animation step of a transition firing.
    FramePort
    A small connection point on a Petri-object frame's border, standing in for one of the object's own places or transitions.
    FramePort.Edge
    Which side of the frame's bounds the port sits on, used to place its label legibly.
    FunRand
    This class contains methods for generating a random value according to a given distribution
    GraphArc
     
    GraphArcFactory
    Builds drawn arcs between two graph elements, wired and positioned.

    GraphArcOut
     
    GraphCanvasModel
    What the editor canvas holds: one drawing, plus the frames that mark out the Petri-objects in it and the places that were joined across those frames.
    GraphCanvasSnapshots
    Exact detached copies of trusted in-memory canvases, preserving IDs and symbolic parameters.
    GraphElement
    Base class for all drawable graph elements (places, transitions, arcs).
    GraphElementIdGenerator
    Central counter for unique graph element IDs.
    GraphNetBuilder
    Builds a drawable GraphPetriNet from a plain PetriNet and the coordinates that came with it.
    GraphObjectFrame
    The frame that marks out one Petri-object on the canvas.
    GraphObjectGroup
    Several Petri-objects made together from one net, and treated as one thing while the model is being built.
    GraphPetriNet
    This class owns the information on the graphic elements and provides creation of a Petri net in accordance
    GraphPetriNet.GraphNetFragment
     
    GraphPetriObject
    One Petri-object of a GraphPetriObjModel: a Petri net plus the properties that only make sense once the net takes part in a composition.
    GraphPetriObjModel
    The graph-level Petri-object model: the Petri-objects a model is composed of and the links between them.

    GraphPetriTransition
     
    GraphPlace
     
    GraphPlaceFusion
    Two places of different Petri-objects drawn, and simulated, as one place.

    PortAnchor
    A fixed point that GraphArc.changeBorder() can trim a line to exactly the way it trims one to a real place or transition — used where a connection's end is not a place or a transition at all, but a port on a locked object's border, or the pointer's current position while a link is still being dragged.
    RecentProjectEntry
    One project the "recent projects" list remembers: where it lives on disk, what it is called, who wrote it, and when it was created, opened and edited.
    RecentProjectsStore
    The "recent projects" registry: ~/.PetriObjModelPaint/data/recent-projects.properties, next to the other per-user data the app keeps outside its config file.

    Centralized resource path configuration for the application.

    SystemThemeDetector
    Asks the desktop whether it is currently in dark mode.
    ThemeMode
    The appearance setting as the user chooses it, which is not the same thing as the appearance that ends up on screen: ThemeMode.SYSTEM has no look of its own, it defers to the desktop and can therefore mean either of the other two depending on the machine the app is started on.
    ThemeVariant
    An appearance that can actually be painted, as opposed to ThemeMode, which is what the user picked and may still be a deferral.
    TransitionFiringListener
    Reports the atomic phases of a firing as they happen.
    UserDirectoryManager
    The UserDirectoryManager class is responsible for managing the local directory structure used by the PetriObjModelPaint application.
